rules.name: Canonical Tag Consistency
rules.description: Page must declare a valid canonical URL to prevent duplicate content indexing.

rules.name: AI Crawler Access & Leak Prevention
rules.description: AI search bots (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot) must be permitted on public routes while private routes (/api/, /admin/) are explicitly disallowed.
rules.remediation: Update robots.txt with dedicated User-agent blocks duplicating private disallows.

rules.name: Page Title Display Preview
rules.description: Page title should be between 30 and 65 characters to avoid SERP snippet truncation.
rules.remediation: Set <title> to 50–60 characters formatted as 'Primary Topic - Key Benefit | Brand'.

rules.name: Meta Description Presence & Length
rules.description: Page should provide a descriptive meta description between 100 and 165 characters.
rules.remediation: Provide <meta name='description' content='...' /> summarizing unique value proposition (120-160 chars).

rules.name: Single Primary Document Outline Heading
rules.description: Page should have exactly one clear primary <h1> heading defining the page topic.
rules.remediation: Ensure exactly one <h1> heading is present and accurately describes the primary entity.

rules.name: Mobile Responsive Viewport
rules.description: Page must define responsive viewport meta tag for mobile indexability.

rules.name: Core Web Vitals Real-User Field Data
rules.remediation: Inspect field metrics via Google Search Console CrUX report.

rules.name: Client-Side Rendering (CSR) Empty Shell Invisibility
rules.description: Pages relying on client-side rendering with empty initial HTML shells are invisible to fast AI search crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot) that do not execute JavaScript.
rules.remediation: Implement Server-Side Rendering (SSR), Static Site Generation (SSG), or pre-rendering so that semantic HTML and Schema.org are delivered in the initial HTTP wire payload.

rules.name: Indexation Directives (Meta Robots / X-Robots-Tag)
rules.description: Pages intended for public search must not specify noindex directives in meta tags or HTTP headers.
rules.remediation: Remove 'noindex' from meta robots or HTTP X-Robots-Tag response header.

rules.name: Image Accessibility & Alternative Text
rules.description: Informational images must provide descriptive alt text for accessibility and search engines.
rules.remediation: Add descriptive alt='...' for content images or alt='' for decorative graphics.
